item.title: The Press Cafe inside Independence Landing opens doors to community
item.description: The cafe helps residents with intellectual disabilities gain real-world job skills while serving the Tallahassee community. Workers gain confidence and practical experience serving real customers.

item.title: Violence down in Remerton after city implements new closing time
item.description: The city changed the bar closing time to 1 a.m. six months ago. Law enforcement say that new time and recent safety upgrades have reduced violence on the strip.

item.title: Local workshop teaches body-based technique to help manage stress and trauma
item.description: A local Tallahassee workshop is teaching TRE exercises that help release built-up tension through natural muscle tremors. Neighbors say this body-based technique is helping them find peace.
